title: Settlement Term for a Charged-Off Settlement Plan (Hardship Assistance Programs)
content:
**Clause.** For the Charged-Off Settlement Plan of the Hardship Assistance Programs, the settlement term — the most monthly installments a borrower may choose for the settlement — is the program's most settlement installments.

Where another rule of this policy replaces the program's most settlement installments, the replacement takes its place; every reduction that applies is then subtracted from it and every addition that applies added to it, in that order, and the result is held between 2 and the program's most settlement installments. The bounds are the program's own minimum of 2 installments and its most settlement installments, never a starting term put in their place. Because the settlement term is held at or above 2, it never works out to 0 installments, and the borrower's recorded choice is never 0.

## Terms of the clause

- *Program's most settlement installments*: the Charged-Off Settlement Plan figure in the special programs terms sheet.
- *Order*: reductions are subtracted and additions added first; the hold between 2 and the program's most settlement installments applies once, to the figure so reached.

## Worked figures (hypothetical; the program's most settlement installments taken as 8 for illustration)

| Starting figure | Reductions | Additions | Figure reached | Settlement term |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 8 | none | none | 8 | 8 |
| 3 | 4 | 2 | 1 | 2 (held at the lower bound) |
| 8 | none | 2 | 10 | 8 (held at the upper bound) |
